name: Nepheg
overview: Nepheg was a male member of the tribe of Judah, known primarily as a son of King David. His mention in Scripture is brief, and no additional personal details or notes are recorded beyond his lineage. As a son of David, he is part of the royal family during a pivotal time in Israel's history.
namesAndTitles: The name Nepheg means 'sprout' or 'shoot,' reflecting a Hebrew proper name. This name is not indicated as being given directly by God. The meaning may symbolically relate to growth or new life, consistent with biblical naming customs.
familyAndRelationships: Nepheg is explicitly identified as a son of David, placing him within the royal household of Judah. No other family relationships are recorded in Scripture for Nepheg beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Nepheg's significance lies in his identity as one of David's sons, contributing to the understanding of David's family and lineage. His mention underscores the historical and genealogical record of the house of David, which is foundational for the Messianic line culminating in Christ. While not prominent in narrative events, Nepheg's inclusion affirms the breadth of David's progeny.
